AGENDA
  GLENDALE ARTS AND CULTURE COMMISSION
  Municipal Services Building, Room 105
  633 E. Broadway, 1st Floor
  Glendale, CA 91206

Welcome to the Regular Meeting of the Arts and Culture Commission. Meetings are broadcast live on cable channel 6
(GTV6) and rebroadcast throughout the week. Call (818) 548-4013 for program schedules. DVD’s of the proceedings are
available for purchase in the City Clerk’s Office. Meetings are also archived on the City Website for viewing anytime at
www.ci.glendale.ca.us/video_archives.asp.
  PLEASE TURN OFF CELLULAR PHONES AND PAGERS WHILE INSIDE THE ROOM.
In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) of 1990, auxiliary hearing aids, sign language translation,
and Braille transcripts are available upon request. Assisted listening devices are available same-day upon request. At
least 48 hours (or two business days) notice is required for requests regarding sign language translation and Braille
transcription services. All documents related to open session items on this agenda that are received less than 72
hours prior to this meeting, and are public records, will be available for review in the office of the Director of the Library,
Arts and Culture Department, 222 E. Harvard Street, 2nd Floor, Glendale, CA 91205. If you have any question about
matters on the agenda, or requests for assistance, please contact the office of the Director of the Library, Arts and Culture
Department, at (818) 548-2030, during regular business hours.
Translation services are provided for meetings through the use of bilingual staff for speakers who wish to utilize the
service as available. Speakers should state their request by contacting the City Clerk’s office at (818) 548-2090, at least
24 hours prior to the scheduled meeting. Please specify the language for which you require translation. The exclusive
use of City provided interpreters is not required and persons are welcome to use their own interpreter or speak in their
native language.

  DECEMBER 19, 2019, at 2:00 p.m.

  1. REGULAR BUSINESS AGENDA – 2:00 p.m.
  Roll Call
  a. Report of Recorder, re: Posting of Agenda. The Agenda for the December 19, 2019
  Regular Meeting was Posted on December 16, 2019 on the Bulletin Board Outside
  City Hall.
  2. CONSENT ITEMS (INCLUDING MINUTES)
  The following are routine and may be acted upon by one motion. Any member of the
  Commission or the audience requesting separate consideration may do so by making such
  request before motion is proposed.
  a. Minutes of the Regular Arts and Culture Commission Meeting of October 17, 2019
  3. INTRODUCTIONS & PRESENTATIONS
  a. Library, Arts & Culture Events – Presented by Jennifer Fukutomi-Jones, Arts &
  Culture Administrator
  4. ORAL COMMUNICATIONS
  Discussion is limited to Items NOT a Part of this Agenda. Each Speaker is Allowed 5
  Minutes. Members of the Arts and Culture Commission may Question or Respond to the
  Speaker, but there will be no Debate or Decision. The Matter may be Referred to Staff
  Through the Commission Chair for Investigation and Report.

  5. ACTION ITEM(s)
  1
   a. Report on the Urban Art Program Plan Update: Community Meeting on
  January 9, 2020
  1. Motion to note and file
  b. Report on the Arts and Culture Commission Website
  1. Motion to note and file
6. DISCUSSION ITEM(s)
  a. 2019-2020 Work Plan Progress
  1. CITY-WIDE ARTS
  i. RFP for Iconic Art Work
  2. NEIGHBORHOOD ARTS
  i. Adams Square Mini Park Gas Station Art Installation – January 2020
  3. PERFORMING ARTS
  i. Performances Application for the Brand Library Plaza Series and 222 East Concert
  Series are due on January 31, 2020
  4. ARTS & CULTURAL EVENTS
  i. Glendale Art Walk RFP – Applications due January 17, 2020

7. COMMISSION/STAFF COMMENTS

8. WRITTEN COMMUNICATIONS

9. ADJOURNMENT

The next regular meeting of the Arts and Culture Commission is January 16, 2020, at 2:00 p.m., in
the Municipal Services Building, Room 105, 633 E. Broadway Glendale, CA 91206.

minutes_text:
CITY OF GLENDALE
  ARTS and CULTURE COMMISSION
  Minutes of Regular Meeting

  Thursday, December 19, 2019 at 2:00 p.m.
1. ROLL CALL
   The meeting was called to order on December 19, 2019 at 2:04 p.m.
   Present: Commissioner Viar, Commissioner Oshagan, Commissioner Tufenkian, Vice Chair Zadorian,
  Chairperson Vidor.
   The Agenda for the December 19, 2019 Regular Meeting was posted on Monday, December 16,
  2019 on the Bulletin Board outside City Hall.

2. CONSENT ITEMS (INCLUDING MINUTES)
  A.  Approval of Regular Meeting Minutes from October 17, 2019.
  Moved:  Vice-Chair Zadorian
  Seconded: Commissioner Tufenkian

  Ayes:  Commissioner Oshagan, Commissioner Tufenkian,
  Vice-Chair Zadorian, Chairperson Vidor
  Noes:  None
  Absent:  None
  Abstain:  Commissioner Viar

3. INTRODUCTIONS & PRESENTATIONS
  A. Library, Arts & Culture Events – Presented by Ms. Fukutomi-Jones, Arts and Culture Commission
  Administrator.
   Ms. Fukutomi-Jones gave an overview of current and upcoming events at Glendale Library,
  Arts & Culture locations.

4. ORAL COMMUNICATIONS
  Speaker(s):
    Jennifer Granville of Glendale Arts spoke about upcoming events at the Alex Theater
  throughout the month of December 2019.

5. ACTION ITEM(s)

  A. Report on the Urban Art Program Plan – Community Update Meeting on January 9, 2020.
  1. Motion to note and file.
    Ms. Fukutomi-Jones gave a brief report on the Urban Art Program Plan – Community
  Update Meeting on January 9, 2020. The Commission asked questions and gave their
  feedback.
  Moved:  Commissioner Tufenkian
  Seconded: Vice-Chair Zadorian

  Ayes:  Commissioner Viar, Commissioner Oshagan, Commissioner Tufenkian,
  1
   Vice-Char Zadorian, Chairperson Vidor
  Noes:  None
  Absent:  None
  Abstain:  None

  B. Report on the Arts and Culture Commission Website
  A. Motion to note and file.
    Ms. Fukutomi-Jones gave a summary on the Arts and Culture Commission Website. Armen
  and Helena Grigorian of Circles 6 presented the final version of the Arts and Culture
  Commission website. The Commission asked questions and gave their feedback.
  Moved:  Vice-Chair Zadorian
  Seconded: Commissioner Tufenkian

  Ayes:  Commissioner Viar, Commissioner Oshagan, Commissioner Tufenkian,
  Vice-Chair Zadorian, Chairperson Vidor
  Noes:  None
  Absent:  None
  Abstain:  None

6. DISCUSSION ITEM(s)
  a.  2019-2020 Work Plan Progress
  1. CITY-WIDE ARTS
  i. RFP for Iconic Art Work
    Ms. Fukutomi-Jones stated that staff will plan to work with the City Attorney’s office on an
  RFQ for an Iconic Art Work Consultant. Staff will present the Commission with a draft of the
  RFQ at the February 20, 2020 Regular Commission Meeting. The Commission gave their
  feedback.

  2. NEIGHBORHOOD ARTS
  i. Adams Square Mini Park Gas Station Temporary Art Installation – January 2020
    Ms. Fukutomi-Jones stated that the next temporary art installation at the Adams Square Mini
  Park Gas Station would be installed on January 21, 2020, by artist Lucas Novak, and would
  be on exhibit from January 21 – February 14, 2020. The Commission gave their feedback.

  3. PERFORMING ARTS
  i. Performances Application for the Brand Library Plaza Series and 222 East Concert Series
    Ms. Fukutomi-Jones stated that the performances application for the Brand Library Plaza
  Series and 222 East Concert Series are due on January 31, 2020. The Commission gave
  their feedback.
  4. ARTS AND CULTURAL EVENTS
  i. Glendale Art Walk RFP
    Ms. Fukutomi-Jones stated that applications for the Glendale Art Walk RFP are due on
  January 17, 2020. The Commission gave their feedback.

7. COMMISSION/STAFF COMMENTS

  2
     Vice-Chair Zadorian and Commissioner Oshagan welcomed Commissioner Viar onto the
  Arts and Culture Commission.

    Chair Vidor expressed thanks for the most recent temporary art installation at the Adams
  Square Mini Park Gas Station, “Hollywood Hustle,” by artist Francisco Cohen.

8. WRITTEN COMMUNICATIONS
    None.

9. ADJOURNMENT
    3:31 p.m.

The next regular meeting of the Arts and Culture Commission is January 16, 2020, at 2:00 p.m., in Room 105
of the Municipal Services Building.
